wmdr:Description.wmdr:description: The station was originally registered based on WMO Pub 9 Vol A information containing these observation remarks: A;EVAP;M/B;NEPH;PH;RBSN(ST);SUNDUR (see code table A for explanations). These remarks imply the following additional observations that could not be registered automatically: Station making reports of sudden changes; Nephoscope observations; Phenological observations.
